gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement p4 has one column, General Fund: total revenues 1,473,726 (Property 241,293 + Sales 182,071 + Motor vehicle 18,413 + Franchise 3,723 + Intergovernmental 535,380 + Permits and fees 2,060 + Charges for services 175,184 + Interest 34,665 + Farm and rental income 29,732 + Grants and contributions 5,787 + Miscellaneous 245,418 = 1,473,726). The General Fund has no schedule of its own; detail holds only the p10 'LB 840 (Component of General Fund)' schedule (revenue 94,943 + 52,195 + 5,177 + 5,500 = 157,815), whose amounts are already inside the General Fund column (component of the General Fund; LB840 sales tax within Sales 182,071, loan repayments within Miscellaneous, etc.). Fix: add the 11 printed General Fund revenue rows and remove the 4 LB 840 revenue lines (detail 0-3), which would otherwise count the same money twice. Check: 157,815 + 1,473,726 - 157,815 = 1,473,726 = statement.
